string.name: addon_onvif_credentials
string.value: Enter the HTTPS service address (private IPv4), username and password for one managed device.

string.name: addon_onvif_choose_hint
string.value: Select a profile. The first profile is not selected automatically.

string.name: addon_onvif_login_failed
string.value: Sign-in or parsing failed. Check the TLS certificate, account permissions, clock and same-origin Media1 address. There is no automatic retry.

string.name: addon_onvif_stream_failed
string.value: Could not obtain the RTSP address for this device.

string.name: addon_onvif_saved_notice
string.value: Stream address saved. The ONVIF sign-in password was not saved.

string.name: addon_onvif_save_failed
string.value: Could not securely save this stream address.

string.name: addon_onvif_read_failed
string.value: Could not read the configuration or device options. Editing is disabled.

string.name: addon_onvif_invalid
string.value: No changes, or a new value is outside the options allowed by this device.

string.name: addon_onvif_applied
string.value: The device confirmed the write. Read the configuration again to verify.

string.name: addon_onvif_unknown
string.value: The device did not confirm the write. The outcome is unknown. Read the configuration again; the request will not be resent.

string.name: addon_onvif_scope
string.value: Connect only to the managed device you specify. Supports trusted HTTPS, private IPv4, Media1 and WS-Security PasswordDigest. HTTP is limited to loopback. Cross-origin requests, HTTP Basic/Digest, PasswordText, Media2 and bypassing certificate checks are not supported.

string.name: addon_onvif_save
string.value: Save selected stream to camera list

string.name: addon_onvif_codec
string.value: Current codec: %s. Only options for this codec can be edited.

string.name: addon_onvif_impact
string.value:
Device: %s
Profile %d · %s
%s
